note: Published LongMemEval numbers for competing memory systems, collected 2026-08-11. THE BAR for Synapse. Every entry is vendor-self-reported unless marked otherwise — there is no neutral LongMemEval leaderboard. `comparable: false` means the number exists but is NOT an apples-to-apples end-to-end QA accuracy on LongMemEval-S and must not be used as a target without saying why. Categories use LongMemEval's own names; `null` = the source does not publish that category.

providers.name: Hindsight
providers.caveat: Per-category values are an aggregation of the published per-question run file (s.json.gz), not a vendor-published table. Weak judge relative to answerer.

providers.name: Mem0
providers.models: harness defaults gpt-4o answerer + gpt-4o judge; a separate table uses GPT-5 for both
providers.caveat: Self-reported, managed-platform pipeline, top-200 retrieval depth.

providers.name: ByteRover
providers.models: Gemini 3.1 Pro answerer, Gemini 3 Flash curation + judge
providers.caveat: Self-reported (vendor blog + arXiv 2604.01599). Judge is the vendor's own curation model.

providers.name: Honcho
providers.models: answerer claude-haiku-4-5, judge GPT-4o, ingestion gemini-2.5-flash-lite
providers.caveat: Self-reported, but raw counts published and per-category totals match the official split exactly (70/56/30/133/133/78).

providers.name: Supermemory
providers.caveat: RETRIEVAL RECALL, not end-to-end QA accuracy — measures whether the evidence was retrieved, not whether the question was answered. Not a valid target for an accuracy number.

providers.name: RetainDB
providers.caveat: ORACLE split — gold evidence sessions are supplied, the easiest setting. Not comparable to _S numbers.

providers.name: OpenViking
providers.caveat: Publishes NO LongMemEval numbers. Its benchmarks are LoCoMo, which is a different dataset and must not be carried over. Unmeasurable on this benchmark.

providers.name: Holographic
providers.caveat: Publishes NO benchmark data of any kind. Unmeasurable on this benchmark.

providers.name: Zep
providers.caveat: Peer-reviewable paper, kept as the prior bar for continuity.

providers.name: full-context gpt-4o
providers.caveat: No-memory reference point: the whole haystack stuffed into context.
